title: Fear Mode
description: Add a VERY difficult game mode that disables chat, armor, skins, and makes the tab list completely incognito.
body:
This plugin if for paper servers of the specific version.

# Overall Experience:

## Features

- Identity Removal
- All players share the same forced skin.
- Nametags are hidden, and the tab list shows “?” for everyone.
- Chat names are blank.
- Silence & Isolation
- All chat is disabled.
- Messaging commands like /msg, /tell, /w, /r, /me, and /emote are blocked.
- Players hear “You yell but only echoes return…” when attempting to speak.
- Survival Restrictions
- Natural regeneration is disabled.
- No death messages; all players hear a wither-spawn sound when someone dies.
- Inventory Limits
- Helmets, chestplates, leggings, books, and signs are automatically removed.
- Boots and shields are allowed.
- Visual Enforcement
- A repeating task re-applies skins, restrictions, and nametag hiding to prevent bypassing.


## FearMode creates an environment where:
- No one can communicate.
- No one can identify anyone.
- No one can heal naturally.
- No deaths or advancements are ever announced.
- Everyone looks identical.
- Armor is stripped away except for boots.
- Every death is felt through ominous sound cues.

## It’s a perfect mode for:
- Horror servers
- Psychological survival challenges
- Hardcore events
- Custom minigames
- ARG-style experiences
